production.note: US model years. Excellence's 911 Carrera S Coupe pages: "2005 911 Carrera S Coupe (997 v1)", with links for 2006, 2007 and 2008 (997 v1) and 2009-2011 (997 v2). MotorWeek tested a 2005 911 Carrera S (motorweek-2005-911-carrera-s). The 997.2 Carrera S from 2009 is a separate car; the Carrera 4S and Targa 4S are separate models.

body.note: "Curb Weight(Coupe/Cabrio)"; Coupe and Cabriolet. The Targa 4 and 4S are separate models.

drivetrain.note: "Rear-wheel-drive, 6-speed manual or optional 5-speed Tiptronic S dual-mode transmission"

transmission.note: "Rear-wheel-drive, 6-speed manual or optional 5-speed Tiptronic S dual-mode transmission". Tiptronic S is a torque-converter automatic.

powerHp.note: Quote (Porsche US brochure specifications, Carrera S column): "Horsepower (SAE) ... 355 hp @ 6600 rpm" (header line "Engine Carrera Carrera S Carrera 4"; row "Horsepower (SAE) 325 hp @ 6800 rpm 355 hp @ 6600 rpm 325 hp @ 6800 rpm"). Unchanged 2005-2008: Excellence 2005 "Horsepower 355 @ 6600 rpm" (excellence-2005-911-carrera-s); MotorWeek 2005 "355".

weightLb.note: Coupe, 6-speed manual. Quote (Porsche US brochure, Carrera S column): "Curb Weight(Coupe/Cabrio)" "3,131/3,318 lbs." and "3,219/3,406 lbs. with Tiptronic S". The brochure is listed by auto-brochures.com as the 2007 US 911 brochure; its text does not print the year (it lists the Targa 4/4S, new for 2007, and "U.S. LEV"). Reference year 2007 because no Porsche figure for 2005 or 2006 was found; Excellence's 2005 page gives the same "Curb Weight 3,131 lbs. manual/3,219 lbs. Tiptronic S" (excellence-2005-911-carrera-s). The brochure prints no year; 2007 rests on the host's file name, the footnote "Gear/handbrake lever in Aluminum-Look (available 11/06)" and the Targa 4/4S (new for 2007). A 2008 brochure would carry the same figures.
